title: SurgStreamer: proactive, request-driven monitoring of surgical video streams with structured state and a reusable reasoning layer
summary: Surgical teams could benefit from assistants that watch the video for requested events, such as "tell me when the clip applier appears during Calot triangle dissection", and answer questions about what has already happened. We formalise this task as request-driven event detection with exact semantics and causal alert decisions, and present SurgStreamer. It separates procedure-specific perception, which maps the 1-FPS stream to a structured state over tools, actions and phases, from procedure-agnostic reasoning, which evaluates a formal monitoring condition over this state and an event memory, either with exact rules or with a small controller that addresses entities through pointers rather than names. We evaluate this monitoring core with gold conditions. On a pre-registered, sealed test set of 12 laparoscopic cholecystectomies, SurgStreamer reached a macro event-F1 of 0.598 over full procedures. On identical 75-s windows with only the window available to every method, it scored 0.677. The tested configurations of the streaming vision-language model OneStreamer-4B, including ones fine-tuned on SurgStreamer's state or on video with an adapted vision encoder, scored at most 0.540 (Holm-adjusted p <= 0.012). At three external centres, re-training only perception raised performance on held-out procedures from 0.239 to 0.470. On a new procedure, pituitary surgery, controller weights trained on cholecystectomy matched an in-domain controller on oracle state (0.947 vs 0.938). On predicted state they missed the pre-registered non-inferiority margin (-0.024 [-0.040, -0.008]) unless the alert thresholds were re-calibrated. The results support separating perception from reasoning and point to perception under distribution shift as the main limitation.
tldr: SurgStreamer is a surgical video monitoring system that separates procedure-specific perception (mapping 1-FPS video to a structured state of tools, actions, and phases) from procedure-agnostic reasoning over user-specified event requests, using formal monitoring conditions and a pointer-based controller. In laparoscopic cholecystectomy benchmarks it outperforms streaming VLM baselines, and the controller transfers to pituitary surgery when perception is available.
tldr_zh: SurgStreamer 是一种手术视频监控系统，将面向特定手术的感知（将1-FPS视频映射为工具、动作、阶段的结构化状态）与跨手术的推理分离，并通过形式化监控条件和基于指针的控制器响应用户事件请求。在腹腔镜胆囊切除术基准上它优于流式视觉语言模型基线，且在感知状态可用时可将控制器迁移到垂体手术中表现良好。
summary_zh: 外科团队可能会受益于这样的助手：它观看手术视频，捕获请求的事件（例如“在Calot三角解剖过程中施夹钳出现时告诉我”），并回答有关已发生事件的问题。我们将该任务形式化为具有精确语义和因果警报决策的请求驱动事件检测，并提出了SurgStreamer。它将特定于手术过程的感知与不依赖手术过程的推理分离开来：前者将1 FPS（每秒1帧）的视频流映射为关于工具、动作和阶段的结构化状态；后者通过精确规则或一个小型控制器，在此状态和事件记忆上评估形式化监控条件，该控制器通过指针而非名称来寻址实体。我们使用真实状态（金标准）条件评估了这一监控核心。在一个预注册、密封的12例腹腔镜胆囊切除术测试集上，SurgStreamer在整个手术过程中的宏平均事件F1达到0.598。在完全相同的75秒窗口（每种方法仅可使用该窗口）上，其得分为0.677。所测试的流式视觉语言模型OneStreamer-4B的各种配置——包括在SurgStreamer的状态上微调，或使用适配后的视觉编码器在视频上微调的配置——最高得分为0.540（Holm校正p <= 0.012）。在三个外部中心，仅重新训练感知部分即可将保留手术上的性能从0.239提升至0.470。在一个新手术——垂体手术上，基于胆囊切除术训练的控制器权重在真实状态下与域内控制器相当（0.947对0.938）。在预测状态下，除非重新校准警报阈值，否则其未达到预注册的非劣效性界值（-0.024 [-0.040, -0.008]）。这些结果支持将感知与推理分离，并指出分布偏移下的感知是主要局限。

title: Bridging the Markerless Tracking Validation Gap: Intraoperative X-ray Workflow Integration
summary: Markerless intraoperative tracking of spinal anatomy via RGB-D sensors is a promising alternative to invasive bone-anchored fiducials, yet no existing clinical dataset provides independent subsurface ground truth for validating these methods. We address this gap with a clinically viable pipeline that derives per-vertebra 6-DoF pose from routine intraoperative C-arm fluoroscopy, co-registered to the RGB-D camera frame through a multimodal fiducial array detectable in both imaging modalities. Critically, the pipeline requires no additional radiation, instrumentation, or deviation from standard surgical workflows, relying solely on the fluoroscopic images already acquired during routine level checks. A calibrated transform chain links the vertebral pose recovered via multi-view 2D-3D CT-to-fluoroscopy registration to the RGB-D coordinate frame, enabling direct comparison of any markerless registration estimate against a subsurface reference. Ex vivo validation against optically tracked ovine vertebrae confirms end-to-end accuracy of 2.06 +- 0.29 mm and 3.35 +- 0.93 degrees, sufficient to serve as independent ground truth for methods with substantially larger errors. We demonstrate the pipeline's utility by evaluating two markerless registration strategies on clinical data spanning 11 vertebrae across 1,500 frames from three surgical sequences: the first such evaluation against an independent subsurface reference in a clinical setting. The proposed framework provides reusable infrastructure for benchmarking emerging markerless tracking methods on real surgical data.
tldr: Presents a clinically integrated validation pipeline that uses routine intraoperative C-arm fluoroscopy to generate per-vertebra 6-DoF ground-truth poses, co-registered to RGB-D camera frames, for benchmarking markerless spinal tracking without extra radiation or workflow changes.
tldr_zh: 提出一种临床可用的验证流程，利用术中常规C臂荧光透视生成每椎骨6自由度位姿作为金标准，并与RGB-D相机坐标系配准，从而无需额外辐射或改变手术流程即可评估无标记脊柱追踪方法。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
通过RGB-D传感器进行无标记的术中脊柱解剖追踪，是侵入性骨锚定基准标记的一种有前景的替代方案，然而现有临床数据集并未提供独立的皮下金标准来验证这些方法。我们通过一种临床可行的流程弥补了这一空白，该流程从常规术中C臂荧光透视中获取每节椎骨的六自由度姿态，并通过在多模态成像中均可检测的基准阵列，将其与RGB-D相机坐标系进行配准。关键在于，该流程无需额外辐射、器械操作或偏离标准手术流程，仅依赖常规节段检查中已采集的荧光透视图像。通过标定的变换链，将基于多视图2D-3D CT到荧光透视配准所恢复的椎骨姿态关联至RGB-D坐标系，从而能够将任意无标记配准估计结果与皮下参考直接比较。离体验证使用光学追踪的绵羊椎骨，确认端到端精度为2.06 ± 0.29 mm和3.35 ± 0.93度，足以作为误差显著较大的方法的独立金标准。我们通过在三段手术序列的1,500帧临床数据（覆盖11节椎骨）上评估两种无标记配准策略，展示了该流程的实用性：这是在临床环境下首次针对独立皮下参考进行的此类评估。所提出的框架为在真实手术数据上对新兴无标记追踪方法进行基准测试提供了可重复使用的基础设施。

title: Auditing Escalation Reliability in Healthcare LLM Agents: A Perturbation-Controlled Benchmark of Workflow-State Failures
summary: Trustworthy biomedical AI requires reliable action selection when evidence is missing, stale, conflicting, or late, not only accurate answers on static inputs. We instantiate an episode-level evaluation protocol as 400 synthetic healthcare workflow episodes: 40 hand-authored semantic seeds across four task classes, two surface parameterizations, and five controlled variants, scored on ANSWER/ASK CLARIFICATION/ABSTAIN/ESCALATE under a pre-declared 5:1 missed-versus-unnecessary escalation cost. Reference actions are single-author study-policy labels, not clinician-adjudicated ground truth. Across five open-weight configurations (1.7B--9.7B), clean decision accuracy reaches 0.97, yet uncertainty-prompted models miss 32--97% of required escalations. The stronger 9.7B configuration narrows but does not remove the gap, falling from 0.97 clean accuracy to 0.78 under conflict. Verbalized confidence is inconsistent (ECE 0.10--0.54; failure AUROC 0.48--0.77), and a development-tuned confidence-only policy yields no utility gain. A transparent workflow-aware controller improves 5:1 utility for every model and reduces missed escalations to 0.12--0.24, at specificity 0.83--0.93. However, a 30-concept lexical stress test reduces each rule detector's recall from 1.00 on trigger phrases to 0.00 on unseen paraphrases, limiting the controller claim to this benchmark. Seed-clustered statistics, ablations, cross-task transfer, raw outputs, and manifests are packaged for audit. The results motivate explicit workflow-state evaluation while showing that apparently effective routing controls need their own generalization tests.
tldr: Introduces an episode-level benchmark of 400 synthetic healthcare workflow scenarios with perturbation-controlled variants to test whether LLM agents correctly choose answer, ask clarification, abstain, or escalate under missing/stale/conflicting/late evidence. Results show high clean accuracy but frequent missed escalations, and a workflow-aware rule controller improves utility yet remains brittle to paraphrased triggers.
tldr_zh: 提出一个包含400个合成医疗工作流场景的篇章级基准，通过受控扰动变体测试LLM代理在证据缺失、过期、冲突或延迟时能否正确选择回答、询问澄清、弃权或升级。结果显示干净数据下准确率高但漏检升级频繁，工作流感知规则控制器可提升效用但面对改写触发词时很脆弱。
summary_zh: 可信赖的生物医学人工智能不仅需要在静态输入上给出准确答案，更需要在证据缺失、过时、冲突或延迟时做出可靠的动作选择。我们实例化了一个基于片段的评估协议，涵盖400个合成医疗工作流片段：跨四个任务类别的40个人工编写的语义种子，两种表面参数化，以及五种受控变体，在预先声明的5：1错过升级与不必要升级成本比下，按“回答/请求澄清/弃权/升级”进行评分。参考动作是单作者研究政策标签，而非临床医生裁定的标准答案。在五种开放权重配置（1.7B至9.7B）中，干净决策准确率达到0.97，但接受不确定性提示的模型遗漏了32%至97%的必要升级。更强的9.7B配置缩小了差距但未消除差距，在冲突情形下准确率从0.97降至0.78。语言化置信度不一致（ECE为0.10至0.54；失败AUROC为0.48至0.77），且经开发调优的仅置信度策略未带来效用提升。一种透明的工作流感知控制器显著提升了每个模型的5：1效用，并将遗漏升级率降至0.12至0.24，特异度为0.83至0.93。然而，一项包含30个概念的词汇压力测试将每个规则检测器的召回率从触发短语上的1.00降至未见改写表述上的0.00，从而将控制器的有效性主张限制在本基准范围内。种子聚类统计、消融实验、跨任务迁移、原始输出及清单均打包以供审计。这些结果既凸显了显式工作流状态评估的必要性，也表明看似有效的路由控制同样需要其自身的泛化测试。

title: TRACER: A Multimodal Harness for Patient Care in Hospitals
summary: Continuous video and clinical records provide complementary information for understanding how patient behavior evolves over a hospital stay. A central challenge is how to represent behavior across the entire stay while preserving access to fine-grained visual and clinical evidence. We introduce TRACER, a training-free multimodal harness that constructs minute-level action records from video and combines them with clinical records into hourly reports. The harness equips an LLM agent with tools to query this hierarchy, inspect relevant video, and retrieve clinical records. To evaluate TRACER, we construct two benchmarks. The first contains 397 annotated one-minute clips spanning 15 atomic actions; the second poses 144 clinician-informed multiple-choice questions, grounded in 264 hours of video and clinical records from two ICU patients. TRACER achieves up to 84.8% accuracy for action detection and 61.0% QA accuracy versus 49.3% for the strongest baseline using the same backbone. Across 280 patients spanning approximately 60,000 camera-hours, TRACER identifies significantly less purposeful activity in patients with a positive delirium assessment during their stay than in those without (p < 0.0001). Our results show that combining continuous video with clinical records can support understanding of patient behavior over time and across patient cohorts without training on protected health data.
tldr: TRACER is a training-free multimodal harness that converts continuous hospital video into minute-level action records, combines them with clinical records into hourly reports, and equips an LLM agent with query tools; it improves action detection and clinical QA accuracy, and reveals significantly less purposeful activity in delirium-positive ICU patients.
tldr_zh: TRACER 是一种无需训练的多模态医疗智能体框架，将医院连续视频转化为分钟级动作记录，并与临床记录整合成小时级报告，使 LLM 智能体可通过工具查询；在动作检测和临床问答上优于基线，并发现谵妄阳性 ICU 患者的有目的活动显著更少。
summary_zh:
摘要：
连续视频和临床记录提供了互补的信息，有助于理解患者在住院期间行为如何演变。一个核心挑战是如何在保留细粒度视觉和临床证据访问能力的同时，表征整个住院期间的行为。我们引入了TRACER，一种无需训练的多模态工具框架，它从视频构建分钟级行为记录，并将其与临床记录组合成小时级报告。该框架为LLM智能体配备了查询这一层级结构、检查相关视频以及检索临床记录的工具。为了评估TRACER，我们构建了两个基准。第一个包含397个带注释的一分钟片段，涵盖15种原子行为；第二个提出了144个由临床医生指导的多项选择题，基于两名ICU患者的264小时视频和临床记录。TRACER在行为检测上达到84.8%的准确率，在问答任务上达到61.0%的准确率，而使用相同主干的最强基线仅为49.3%。在涵盖约60,000摄像头小时的280名患者中，TRACER识别出住院期间谵妄评估阳性的患者比阴性患者表现出显著更少的目的性活动（p < 0.0001）。我们的结果表明，将连续视频与临床记录相结合，可以在不依赖受保护健康数据进行训练的情况下，支持对患者行为随时间及跨患者队列的理解。

title: Documenting Trofinetide Treatment Phenotypes in Rett Syndrome with a Dual-LLM Consensus Pipeline
summary: Objective: Trofinetide, approved in 2023 as the first Rett syndrome treatment, lacks scalable real-world monitoring because chart review is labor-intensive. We developed a dual large language model (LLM) consensus pipeline to extract 18 treatment-response phenotypes, comprising 4 adverse effects, 13 Rett clinical features, and medication refusal, from clinical notes. Materials and Methods: We analyzed 26,763 notes from 108 patients with confirmed sustained trofinetide exposure at Texas Children's Hospital. The pipeline filters notes by keyword, classifies each through two LLMs requiring consensus, and aggregates a patient-by-timepoint matrix. Architecture and prompt were selected on a diarrhea development set, then frozen and applied to the other 17 phenotypes with the phenotype definition substituted, as an out-of-sample test. The reported prompt comparison scores 183 expert-labeled cells. Results: A prompt requiring diarrhea to be active and severe performed best (84.2 $\pm$ 0.0% accuracy; F1 = 0.674), 47 percentage points above regular-expression matching ($p < 0.0001$). Expert reviewers judged six of the pipeline's calls per phenotype, three positive and three negative, and agreed with 90.2% (92/102). The 13 Rett clinical features are manifestations of the disorder itself rather than adverse effects of trofinetide. Gross and fine motor impairment, language/communication, and stereotypy were documented present in 92-100% of patients at every visit. Discussion: In-context LLM extraction captured multi-domain treatment responses. The outcome is documented presence at each visit, not a direction-of-change judgment. Conclusion: Coupling in-context LLM reasoning with a consensus architecture offers a scalable alternative to keyword and regular-expression extraction for real-world evidence, adapting to new phenotypes and medications through configuration alone.
tldr: The paper presents a dual-LLM consensus pipeline that extracts 18 trofinetide treatment-response phenotypes from Rett syndrome clinical notes. It outperforms regex matching and achieves high expert agreement, offering a configurable, scalable approach for real-world clinical evidence extraction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种双大语言模型共识流水线，用于从Rett综合征临床笔记中提取18种曲非奈德治疗反应表型。该方法优于正则表达式匹配，并达到较高的专家一致性，为真实世界临床证据提取提供了可配置、可扩展的方案。
summary_zh: 摘要：目的：Trofinetide于2023年获批成为首个雷特综合征治疗药物，但由于病历审查耗时费力，目前缺乏可扩展的真实世界监测手段。我们开发了一种双大语言模型（LLM）共识流程，用于从临床记录中提取18种治疗反应表型，包括4种不良反应、13种雷特临床特征及拒药行为。材料与方法：我们分析了德州儿童医院108例确诊持续暴露于trofinetide的患者的26,763条记录。该流程通过关键词筛选记录，经两个LLM进行分类并要求共识，然后汇总生成患者-时间点矩阵。架构和提示词在腹泻开发集上选定，随后固定不变，仅替换表型定义后应用于其余17种表型，作为样本外测试。所报告的提示词对比评分基于183个专家标注单元格。结果：要求腹泻为活动性且严重的提示词表现最佳（准确率84.2±0.0%；F1=0.674），比正则表达式匹配高出47个百分点（p<0.0001）。专家评审员对每种表型评估了流程的6次判定（3次阳性、3次阴性），同意率达90.2%（92/102）。13种雷特临床特征是疾病本身的临床表现，而非trofinetide的不良反应。粗大和精细运动障碍、语言/沟通障碍及刻板行为在每次就诊时均有92-100%的患者被记录存在。讨论：上下文LLM提取能够捕获多领域治疗反应。结局指标是每次就诊时的记录存在情况，而非变化方向判断。结论：将上下文LLM推理与共识架构相结合，为真实世界证据提供了一种可扩展的替代关键词和正则表达式提取的方法，仅通过配置即可适应新表型和药物。

title: MedPAO-VL: Interpretable and Protocol-Compliant Agent for Structured Radiology Report Generation
summary: Despite the remarkable generalization capabilities of Large Language Models, generating clinically accurate and structured radiology reports from medical images remains a significant challenge. Current end-to-end approaches function as black boxes, prone to factual hallucinations and generating ungrounded findings. This lack of reliability and failure to adhere to domain-specific structuring protocols, fundamentally limits their clinical utility. We present MedPAO-VL, a multimodal agent that shifts the paradigm from monolithic generation to explainable, iterative, protocol-compliant structured report generation. Unlike deterministic models, our plan-act-observe loop functions as a goal-oriented agent: it first perceives the Chest X-Ray through an explainable vision module designed to capture inherent diagnostic uncertainty, then iteratively refines the generated report by observing semantic discrepancies and self-correcting its generation for better alignment with visually detected clinical findings. Evaluation of our framework demonstrates that this agentic reasoning improves clinical correctness and completeness, achieving an expert-rated accuracy score of 3.5/5 and a structural score of 4.3/5. By prioritizing pathology specific explainability and iterative refinement over opaque end-to-end mapping, MedPAO-VL offers a transparent and clinically viable alternative for automated structured radiology report generation.
tldr: MedPAO-VL is a multimodal agent for structured chest X-ray report generation that uses a plan-act-observe loop with an explainable vision module and iterative self-correction to improve clinical accuracy and protocol compliance, achieving expert-rated accuracy 3.5/5 and structural score 4.3/5.
tldr_zh: MedPAO-VL 是一种用于胸部 X 光结构化报告生成的多模态智能体，通过“规划-执行-观察”循环、可解释视觉模块和迭代自校正来提升临床准确性与协议符合度，专家评分准确率为3.5/5、结构评分为4.3/5。
summary_zh:
摘要：
尽管大型语言模型具有显著的泛化能力，但从医学图像生成临床准确且结构化的放射学报告仍然是一项重大挑战。当前的端到端方法如同黑盒，容易产生事实性幻觉并生成无根据的发现。这种缺乏可靠性以及对领域特定结构化协议遵循的不足，从根本上限制了其临床实用性。我们提出了MedPAO-VL，一种多模态智能体，它将范式从整体式生成转变为可解释、迭代、符合协议的结构化报告生成。与确定性模型不同，我们的“计划-行动-观察”循环作为一个目标导向的智能体运行：它首先通过一个旨在捕获内在诊断不确定性的可解释视觉模块感知胸部X光片，然后通过观察语义差异并自我纠正生成过程，以更好地与视觉检测到的临床发现对齐，从而迭代地优化生成的报告。对我们框架的评估表明，这种智能体推理提高了临床正确性和完整性，达到了专家评分的准确度3.5/5和结构评分4.3/5。通过优先考虑病理特异性可解释性和迭代优化，而非不透明的端到端映射，MedPAO-VL为自动化结构化放射学报告生成提供了一种透明且临床可行的替代方案。

title: MindEval2: Clinically Grounded Patients and Rubrics for Evaluating Language Models in Mental Health Support
summary: With people increasingly turning to AI chatbots for mental health support, the need to evaluate these tools is becoming more pressing. Recent benchmarks attempt to mimic a realistic setting by simulating multi-turn interactions with synthetic patients and evaluating them with an LLM-as-a-judge. However, the usefulness of these methods is limited because simulated patients can be overly forthcoming and self-reflective, and judgments typically involve opaque Likert scales with unclear practical utility. To bridge these gaps, we introduce MindEval2, an evaluation framework that consists of two components: Mental Health Quality Rubrics (MHQR), for evaluation, and MindSim, for patient simulation. For MHQR, we collaborate with PhD-level psychologists to develop a set of rubrics that break down response quality into explicit operational criteria that are more interpretable and actionable than existing evaluation taxonomies. MindSim, in turn, is an LLM harness that combines carefully-designed patient profiles with tools, enabling more varied, challenging, and realistic interactions than existing baselines. The harness also contains a memory component that is updated between each interaction, enabling MindEval2 to model the longitudinal aspect of mental health. We evaluate 18 proprietary and open-weight models on MindEval2, finding that while frontier models have largely improved on issues related to surface level quality and boundaries, guidance calibration remains the dominant failure mode across all models, accounting for most of the quality gap.
tldr: MindEval2 is an evaluation framework for LLM-based mental health support, combining psychologist-designed rubrics (MHQR) and a more realistic patient simulator (MindSim) with memory to assess response quality over longitudinal interactions. Benchmarking 18 models shows most quality gap comes from guidance calibration, not surface-level issues.
tldr_zh: MindEval2 是一个面向大语言模型心理健康支持场景的评估框架，包含心理学家设计的质量标准（MHQR）和更具真实感、带记忆的患者模拟器（MindSim），可评估纵向多轮交互中的回复质量。对18个模型的测评显示，主要质量差距来自引导校准而非表层回应问题。
summary_zh: 随着人们越来越多地转向AI聊天机器人寻求心理健康支持，评估这些工具的需求日益迫切。近期的基准测试试图通过模拟与合成患者的多轮交互，并借助LLM-as-a-judge（以大语言模型为裁判）进行评估，来模拟真实场景。然而，这些方法的实用性受到限制，因为模拟患者可能过于主动坦露和自我反思，而评判通常涉及不透明的李克特量表，缺乏明确的实际效用。为弥补这些不足，我们提出了MindEval2，一个由两个组件构成的评估框架：用于评估的心理健康质量量规（MHQR），以及用于患者模拟的MindSim。对于MHQR，我们与博士级心理学家合作，开发了一套量规，将响应质量分解为明确的操作性标准，比现有评估分类法更具可解释性和可操作性。MindSim则是一个大语言模型（LLM）工具框架，结合了精心设计的患者档案与工具，能够实现比现有基线更多样、更具挑战性和更真实的交互。该框架还包含一个在每次交互之间更新的记忆组件，使MindEval2能够模拟心理健康的纵向变化过程。我们在MindEval2上评估了18个专有和开源权重模型，发现虽然前沿模型在表层质量和边界相关问题上已有较大改进，但指导校准（guidance calibration）仍是所有模型的主要失败模式，占据了大部分质量差距。
